title: [29x]-Adjust Cost creates an additional unexpected variance amount due to rounding precision during cost adjustment
summary: Fixed a rounding precision issue in the Adjust Cost process that was creating unexpected variance amounts during inventory cost adjustments.
key_points: Rounding precision errors were causing additional variances during cost adjustment calculations
The fix applies to inventory and assembly costing modules
Test case added to verify the rounding behavior is correct
Changes affect both W1 and localized versions (APAC, RU)
quote: Adjust Cost creates an additional unexpected variance amount due to rounding precision during cost adjustment
